system_texts: The remote case should be hard plastic and transparent to enable backlighting.
Five interchangeable front panels will be provided in a box and used on the remote.
The Real Reaction logo will be placed on the remote, and the fronts on the remote should be replaceable.
LED colors will be blue, red, and green; color cannot be chosen at purchase; color can be changed after purchase; there are multiple LEDs.
The remote will use rubber buttons for three-dimensional curved remotes; two-D curved design; wheel should be round; numbers at bottom; switch channel in the middle.
Skip the LCD option and use the second most expensive chip; use the regular chip; titanium will not be used.
gold_texts: The group decided to use a scroll button for volume control.
The scroll wheel could be small and yellow, to match the Real Reaction colours.
The remote will include rechargeable batteries and will be used with a recharging stand.
The remote will feature plastic buttons and casing, rather than rubber.
The remote will not feature an LCD screen.
The remote will have rounded corners and be curved in two dimensions only, not in depth.
The group decided to design five changeable faces for the device.
They eventually decided to incorporate speech recognition and an advanced chip.
The remote will open up to hold the speech recognition functions.
